This plot is very small, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer for it. One bag is too much for this piece, and I do not want to spend cash there when I can carry manure and compost from home and put it around the trees and the intercrop. I will keep the local planting material I already know, and I will water this plot when the rain is not enough because a small fruit plot like this can be managed by family hands.
